excerpt: What personal injury settlements realistically range by case type, why averages mislead, and the factors that actually drive case value.
keyTakeaways: Settlement ranges by type: car accidents $15K-$75K, truck $50K-$500K+, motorcycle $30K-$150K, slip and fall $10K-$50K, med mal $100K-$1M+, wrongful death $500K-$5M+. Georgia caps punitive at $250K (O.C.G.A. § 51-12-5.1). SC caps at 3x or $500K (S.C. Code § 15-32-530). About 95% of cases settle.

faqs.question: What is the average personal injury settlement?
faqs.answer: National averages are misleading. Ranges by type: car accidents $15K-$75K, truck $50K-$500K+, slip and fall $10K-$50K, med mal $100K-$1M+, wrongful death $500K-$5M+.

faqs.question: Why do amounts vary so much?
faqs.answer: Key variables include injury severity, medical costs, lost income, permanent impairment, liability clarity, available insurance, jurisdiction, and attorney skill.

faqs.question: Do most cases settle or go to trial?
faqs.answer: About 95% settle before trial. Having an attorney prepared to go to trial leads to higher settlement offers.

faqs.question: How long to receive a settlement?
faqs.answer: Most settle 6-18 months after MMI. Complex cases can take 2-3 years.

faqs.question: Are settlements taxable?
faqs.answer: Compensation for physical injuries is generally not taxable. Punitive damages and interest are taxable.

faqs.question: How can I get a realistic estimate?
faqs.answer: Free consultation with an experienced attorney who can review records, calculate damages, and provide a range based on comparable cases.
